label: Pull request
intent: A pull request is opened from the branch. Light: the request route pulls back into the branch commit, which swells as it gathers it, then the route draws out again down and across toward the trunk; the arrowhead rides in on its tip, lands with a hit, thrusts toward the trunk without joining it, recoils and settles. Strong: the branch gathers longer, the route shoots out faster, the arrowhead thrusts further, the trunk flinches from the knock, and both settle in two beats. The commits never shrink.

tail.//: drawn from the branch commit to the arrowhead, so draw retracts it into the branch

motion.//: Set 31's visual check needs the three commit openings clear at 32 px in every frame, so the branch only swells and bounces back down onto its size. The tail draws at constant speed, so the head rides its tip over the last 2 units (12.4% of the route).
